propositions: Status mapping is currently hardcoded; it must become config-driven per project, merging builtin defaults with project-specific overlays via the S1 mapping core.
An unmapped local status must drift (omit the status field, leave Jira unchanged) with a deduped alert, never coerce or skip.
Config remaps and collapsed status pairs must round-trip losslessly via rebar-status:<local> labels without requiring a reverse map, recovering the original local status on inbound.

The outbound mapper seam must resolve the effective status map per project from repo_root, threading it through all CREATE/UPDATE paths via an optional status_map parameter on the OutboundMapper Protocol.
Config-declared Jira status names must be tolerated by both the fetcher known-set and the preflight validator, not triggering spurious warnings.
The duplicated rebar-status label parsing logic must be unified into a shared helper with a derived vocabulary covering every local status the stamp rule can emit.
